title: Oroxylin A exerts antiproliferative effects through downregulation of E6 and E7 oncogenes in cervical cancer HeLa cells.
authors: Hu, Shan; Lu, Yongting; Pandey, Pratibha; Mujtaba, Md Ali; Pandey, Shivam; Lakhanpal, Sorabh; Verma, Meenakshi; Khan, Fahad
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮化合物oroxylin A通过下调HPV E6/E7癌基因抑制宫颈癌细胞增殖，涉及分子对接但核心是细胞实验与基因表达，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Numerous plant compounds have shown promising antitumor potential against cervical cancer. Plant-based compounds offer abundantly available, easy, and inexpensive methods of treatment over genome-editing technologies (immunotherapeutics). Many flavonoids directly abrogated HPV-E6/E7 activity with a concomitant apoptotic conclusion. Cervical cancer initiation and progression are entirely dependent on the oncogenes E6 and E7 (constitutively expressed) leading to tumorigenesis. Therefore, the manipulation of these oncogenes is the most prominent form of cervical cancer therapeutics. To further explore the mechanism underlying apoptosis induction, ROS generation, apoptosis-related gene expression (Bcl-2, caspases-3, caspases-8, and caspases-9), viral oncogenes (E6/E7), and tumor suppressor proteins (p53/pRb) were evaluated using MTT, cell cycle arrest, Hoechst, docking, and RT-PCR analysis. This study showed that oroxylin A (OrA) effectively inhibited HeLa cell proliferation at the respective doses. This study suggests that OrA inhibits E6/E7 mRNAs, leading to the upregulation of p53/pRb (tumor suppressor genes) in HeLa cells. Moreover, OrA induced p53-mediated apoptosis induction, activating the transcription of various proapoptotic genes, including Bcl-2 and Bax. Alternatively, p53 triggers apoptosis by promoting the caspase activation. In conclusion, OrA targeting E6/E7 was highly effective in inhibiting cancer cell proliferation via the upregulation of suppressor genes in cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 众多植物化合物已展现出对抗宫颈癌的潜力性抗肿瘤效果。相较于基因组编辑技术（免疫疗法），植物来源的化合物提供了丰富易得、简便且成本低廉的治疗方法。许多黄酮类化合物直接抑制了HPV-E6/E7的活性，并伴随凋亡结局。宫颈癌的发生与发展完全依赖于致癌基因E6和E7（组成性表达），从而引发肿瘤形成。因此，调控这些致癌基因是宫颈癌治疗中最突出的方式。为进一步探索凋亡诱导的机制，通过MTT、细胞周期阻滞、Hoechst染色、分子对接及RT-PCR分析，评估了ROS生成、凋亡相关基因表达（Bcl-2、caspase-3、caspase-8和caspase-9）、病毒致癌基因（E6/E7）及肿瘤抑制蛋白（p53/pRb）。本研究表明，木蝴蝶素A（oroxylin A, OrA）在相应剂量下有效抑制了HeLa细胞增殖。该研究提示，OrA抑制E6/E7 mRNA，导致HeLa细胞中p53/pRb（肿瘤抑制基因）上调。此外，OrA诱导p53介导的凋亡，激活包括Bcl-2和Bax在内的多种促凋亡基因的转录。或者，p53通过促进caspase激活来触发凋亡。总之，OrA靶向E6/E7，通过上调宫颈癌中的抑制基因，高效抑制癌细胞增殖。
